metadata.name: Market Town
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A walled market town (Style Pack 10: Medieval Village). The Embers camp outside the south wall; the Tide hold the churchyard round the bell tower. Through the gate (a portcullis; a ladder up to its roof) or the gaps at either end of the wall, over the stream by one of three stone bridges, up the high street to the market square, its fountain and the market hall. Half-timbered houses to fight through room by room, upper floors joined door to door and by a walkway over the street, outside stairs onto red tile roofs you can run along, a watchtower at each end and the bell tower watching the whole high street.
